import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[0]
    s = np.sin(w*t); c = np.cos(w*t)
    return (params[1]*c*np.sqrt(v) + params[2]*s*v + params[3]*c + params[4]*s
            + params[5]*v*np.abs(v) + params[6] + params[7]*v + params[8]*x*s + params[9]*x)
